landing.hero_headline: Know the real cost of driving electric.
landing.hero_subheadline: Flux tracks your Tesla's energy costs, charging sessions, and smart-charges on your actual Romanian tariff — so you always pay less.
landing.feature_ocr_desc: Snap a photo of any electricity bill and Flux extracts kWh, cost, and provider automatically — no manual entry.
landing.feature_tariff_desc: Electrica, E.ON, Enel, Hidroelectrica — Flux knows your exact rates and calculates home-charging cost down to the cent.
landing.feature_smart_desc: We read your tariff price curve and tell you the cheapest hour to start charging. One tap to schedule.
landing.feature_i18n_desc: Available in Romanian, English, German, French, and Hungarian. Costs shown in RON, EUR, or your preferred currency.
landing.pricing_teaser_title: Start free, upgrade when you need more.
landing.pricing_teaser_desc: Free plan covers one vehicle and three OCR documents per month. Pro is €4.99 / month for unlimited everything.
